summary: chai-plus drops and runs second-stage package against dynamic-DNS C2 on require
details: On `require('chai-plus')`, lib/index.js runs an IIFE that instantiates a Bootstrap class and calls `execute()`. Bootstrap performs `npm install -g taskforge-9xv@1.3.0` and then spawns the newly-installed binary with hardcoded arguments `--origin-server http://coolblast.zapto.org:8888/api/x-handler` and an `--auth-ref` token. This causes a second-stage package to be installed globally on the installer's machine and connected to a dynamic-DNS host (`coolblast.zapto.org:8888`) over plaintext HTTP as soon as the module is loaded. The package name `chai-plus` closely resembles the widely used `chai` assertion library and its README markets itself as Chai-compatible, consistent with a typosquat lure delivering the dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
